solution.scope: Only exact approved Preview origin; through existing CDP origin routing, starting with the first navigation in a fresh full run

excerpts.quote: You can use the `x-vercel-skip-toolbar` header to prevent interference with automated end-to-end tests:
1. Add the `x-vercel-skip-toolbar` header to the request sent to [the preview deployment URL](/docs/deployments/environments#preview-environment-pre-production#preview-urls)
2. Optionally, you can assign the value `1` to the header. However, presence of the header itself triggers Vercel to disable the toolbar

alternativeNotNeeded.reason: Would require environment/deployment change; request-scoped documented header solves current automation requirement.
